rules.label: RB-RB start
rules.note: Open with two running backs where the board allows it.

rules.label: Don't end R4 at 2RB/2WR
rules.note: Two RBs and two WRs through four rounds leaves QB and TE both unfilled — spend one of the next picks on a onesie.

rules.label: QB after the top two
rules.note: Happy to take a high-tier QB, but not Josh Allen or Lamar Jackson at their price.

rules.label: No premium onesie TE
rules.note: Not paying up for a top-tier TE, but do not want to be shut out by a run either.

rules.label: Rookies and handcuffs late
rules.note: Once every starting slot is filled, the picks before kicker and defence go on handcuffs and on a named shortlist of rookie receivers. The shortlist is hand-kept and ordered by the offence a rookie lands in rather than by projection: Tennessee and Cleveland price under four points across every skill position with no ranked quarterback, and Philadelphia grades well but its scheme fades the third receiver, so a good offence is not the same as a good role. Jordyn Tyson is on the do-not-draft list and is a flier only, being on IR. A back-up behind one of your own starters comes first, since it insures a player already paid for.
